name: Should I sell my Airbnb property furnished or unfurnished?

mainEntity.name: Should I sell my Airbnb property furnished or unfurnished?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to sell your Airbnb property furnished or unfurnished depends on your target buyer and local market expectations. Selling furnished can be attractive to investors seeking a turnkey operation, especially if your furnishings are modern and appealing, as it allows for immediate rental income without additional setup costs. However, it might deter buyers who prefer to customize the space or are not interested in short-term rentals. A practical tradeoff is that selling furnished might command a slightly higher price but could narrow the buyer pool, whereas unfurnished offers broader appeal. Our team can advise on the common preferences of buyers in areas like Palm Beach County.
